name: Radu Stoian MCP Server & Agent Tools
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing dynamic question answering, section retrieval, and external investigation links over radustoian.com knowledge files with fail-safe fallback, plus client-side WebMCP tools.

tools.name: ask-question
tools.description: Answers generic or specific questions about Radu Stoian by dynamically retrieving the most relevant content block from profile documents (llms-full.txt, index.md.txt, metadata.json, index.html). If no specific block is matched, automatically provides the entire content of llms-full.txt as a fail-safe default answer along with external investigation links.

question.description: The question to ask about Radu Stoian

tools.name: get-section
tools.description: Returns the full text and content blocks of a specific section from llms-full.txt (e.g. 'Skills and Certifications', 'Projects and Clients', 'Client Testimonials', 'Publications and Insights').

section.description: Name or keyword of the section to retrieve

tools.name: get-investigation-links
tools.description: Returns external links and public profiles for AI agents to investigate Radu Stoian (LinkedIn, GitHub, Substack, SpeakerDeck, Credly, Google Skills, etc.).

tools.name: server-info
tools.description: Returns information about this MCP server, runtime environment, and available data sources.
